description: Geneva quasi-resident status (≥90% income taxed in CH). · Statut de quasi-résident genevois (≥90% des revenus imposés en CH). — Tells a Geneva cross-border worker whether they qualify as a quasi-résident — i.e. at least ~90% of the household's worldwide income is taxable in Switzerland — which unlocks itemised deductions on the Geneva tax return. Deterministic threshold rule — no AI. Returns eligibility, the share, the threshold, and the data year.

swiss_income.description: Income taxable in Switzerland (same currency as total_income).
